observed_structure: A value-head guard precedes a serial traversal of the runtime-width core row, where one source-level float accumulator receives value-squared contributions.
The kernel divides the accumulated square sum by params.value_dim, adds params.rms_norm_eps, and applies rsqrt.
A second serial loop reads each core element again and multiplies it by the inverse-RMS scalar and the direct norm_weight factor.
That output expression also reads projected Z, computes a SiLU factor, and writes the fused product to the gated buffer.
variant_notes: One grid thread handles each admitted value head with a runtime params.value_dim extent and a serial accumulation order.
The kernel uses norm_weight[index] directly and fuses a separately read projected-Z SiLU factor into the gated output; neither choice is normalized into the shared pattern.
The source-level second read does not establish a physical device-memory reread or any bandwidth result.
